newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Soundwill to issue 300 mln shrs in IPO - sources.
newsitem.headline: Soundwill to issue 300 mln shrs in IPO - sources.

text.p: Construction and property firm Soundwill Holdings Ltd is expected to issue 300 million new shares at about HK$2.10 per share in its initial public offer (IPO) in Hong Kong, market sources said on Wednesday.
The issue price is expected to represent about 30 percent discount to net asset value per share, sources said.
Soundwill engages in property redevelopment and investment in Hong Kong, they said. ING Baring is the sponsor of the issue.
The firm is to hold a company presentation on Thursday, the sources said. The IPO is expected in March.
